name: Osananajimi to no Kurashikata
original_name: 幼なじみとの暮らし方
source: This is a story about the protagonist, Yuuki Makoto and Nekomiya Nono from [url=/v566]Yotsunoha[/url] living together, while enjoying their romantic life and time under the same roof, despite all the hardships they have and will have to face.
translation: 本作讲述[url=/v566]《四叶草》[/url]中的主人公结城诚与猫宫乃乃共同生活的故事。尽管两人已经面对、未来也仍会面对许多困难，他们依旧在同一屋檐下享受恋爱与共处的时光。
